_source.why: The SDK keeps public release notes in CHANGELOG.md rather than a RELEASE_NOTES module, so this file is the structured notes source consumed by publish-cli-releases.mjs.

0.9.17.title: No-op forgetting and artifact-complete compliance
notes: Forgetting a workspace that was never recorded is now a true filesystem no-op: it creates neither the recent-session index nor a tombstone shard.
The standard compliance gate now audits built artifacts as well as source, preventing a successful gate from replacing the artifact ownership inventory with an empty report.
The installed Windows contention probe retained 360 concurrent recent-session updates across 12 processes with no lock or temporary-file debris.

0.9.16.title: Lossless Windows continuation state
notes: Unqualified recent-session reads now honor XENO_AGENT_HOME, so isolated runs cannot import entries from the operator's default state directory.
Recent-session updates persist one atomic shard per normalized workspace and merge those shards over the compact index.
Concurrent Windows processes no longer lose completed session updates on mapped or filtered filesystems where exclusive lock creation is not reliably exclusive.
PowerShell sideband completion drains the final stdout before settling.

0.9.15.title: Durable sessions and unbounded managed continuation
notes: Managed continuation is event-driven and unbounded by default; the historical three-turn default is removed while explicit bounded policies remain supported.
Active legacy checkpoints migrate to the new continuation contract.
Finite background operations remain attached to their original objective across repeated completion and resume cycles.
Recent-session index updates are serialized across processes with bounded Windows atomic-replace retries, eliminating rename-warning floods under ordinary contention.
Background tasks receive semantic sanitized labels without exposing raw command arguments.
